title: A Comparison of Approaches to Large-Scale Data Analysis
authors: Andrew Pavlo, Erik Paulson, Alexander Rasin, Daniel J. Abadi, David J. DeWitt, Samuel Madden, Michael Stonebraker
description: Benchmarks Hadoop MapReduce against two parallel SQL DBMSs (Vertica and DBMS-X) on a 100-node cluster across five analytical tasks, finding that the parallel databases were consistently 3–6x faster while Hadoop was substantially easier to install and load data into.
